spec.name: sprint47_taker_imbalance_continuation_btc_eth
spec.hypothesis: Extreme 30m taker-buy/sell imbalance (rolling 1st/99th percentile) predicts same-direction BTC/ETH drift over the next 60m that exceeds round-trip costs.
spec.power_argument: Expected validation trades ~400 (>=300). Per-trade sd ~50bps, SE ~2.5bps, min detectable net edge ~6-7bps at t~2.5. Percentile thresholds guarantee trigger frequency, avoiding the n=0 failure of sprint44-46. Null-fail criterion: mean net <=0 or t<2.5.
